description.value: TAKO is a Korean-fusion fast food shop specializing in tacos, burritos, quesadillas, bibimbap bowls, and poutine built around Korean BBQ fillings like bulgogi, spicy pork belly, and BBQ short rib. It sits directly across from Rogers Arena at the Stadium/Chinatown SkyTrain stop, putting it squarely on Vancouver's inner-harbour cycling corridor. The outdoor patio makes it a natural drop-in stop for cyclists exploring the nearby seawall.
